faq_heading: Queen Mary Park houses: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Queen Mary Park. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Queen Mary Park, Surrey: 66 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 2 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 3%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 10 of 15 Surrey communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Surrey total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Queen Mary Park rose from 63 in June to 66 in October (+4.8%), and 15 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 6.4% of Surrey’s 1,033 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Queen Mary Park?
Queen Mary Park also had 84 condos and townhomes listed and 7 sold in October, against 66 houses listed. The Queen Mary Park condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Queen Mary Park home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

43 houses sold in Queen Mary Park with a median price of $1,178,500 (the middle half sold between $1,045,750 and $1,519,000), taking a median of 28 days to sell at 95.3% of the last list price; 7% sold above list. They had a median $476 per square foot, a median year built of 1984 and a median lot of 7,450 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Queen Mary Park?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 66 houses listed in Queen Mary Park. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Queen Mary Park a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Queen Mary Park had a sales ratio of 3%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Queen Mary Park from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 15 houses sold in Queen Mary Park over those 5 months, out of 464 in all of Surrey.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Queen Mary Park?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Queen Mary Park sell for?
faq.a: 43 houses sold in Queen Mary Park between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,178,500.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Queen Mary Park?
faq.a: The median was 28 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.3% of the last list price (7% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
